Publish.LongDescription:
## Not Enough Customers Fix
The problem was not merely too few shoppers. During the low-shopping part of the day, businesses were replenishing Service faster than the available customers could consume it.
* This is a more realistic of how businesses operate in real life. They are going to reduce total workers or send them on long breaks during low traffic times of the day. * Adaptive and follows what vanilla already does to balance shopping economy: * Strong recovery when badly out of balance, no intervention once healthy.
* I also suggest making sure you don't have 100 vehicle shops and only 1 food shop. Having a little of everything is still the best way to keep your city healthy as cims look to fill needs.
